name: derko-site
description: DERKO statische Website – Bildoptimierung via sharp

scripts.copy: cpy "assets/**" dist/assets --dot --cwd=. && cpy "pages/**" dist/pages --dot --cwd=. && cpy "lang/**" dist/lang --dot --cwd=. && cpy "api/**" dist/api --dot --cwd=. --ignore="**/.debug" --ignore="**/error.log" && cpy "components/**" dist/components --dot --cwd=. && cpy ".well-known/**" dist/.well-known --dot --cwd=. && cpy "robots.txt" "sitemap.xml" "site.webmanifest" ".htaccess" dist --dot --cwd=.
scripts.build:js: esbuild assets/js/email-reveal.js assets/js/error-rate-limit.js assets/js/kontakt.js assets/js/lang.js assets/js/main.js assets/js/partners.js assets/js/wohnung-detail.js --minify --sourcemap=external --outdir=dist/assets/js
scripts.build:html: html-minifier-terser --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --minify-css true --minify-js true --file-ext html --input-dir pages --output-dir dist/pages && html-minifier-terser --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --minify-css true --minify-js true --file-ext html --input-dir lang --output-dir dist/lang && if exist index.html html-minifier-terser --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --minify-css true --minify-js true -o dist/index.html index.html
scripts.build: npm-run-all clean copy build:js build:css build:html
scripts.//docker: Startet Apache+PHP 8.2 + Mailpit via Docker. Web: http://localhost:8081 | Mail-UI: http://localhost:9000. Docker Desktop muss laufen.
